## History

Gertie Pye was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned to school after a prolonged absence, she and her fellow students warmly welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back. Later, Gertie attended the successful [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school concert where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) performed.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
